title: Left unitor with the compared coefficient unit
statement:
Let $T$ be a scheme with its small etale and pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]. Let $\mathcal B$ be a Grothendieck abelian, symmetric monoidal closed category, with additive tensor product and functorial flat resolutions, so the sheaf derived tensor is defined [def-weil-derived-tensor]. Write $
u_T^*$ for the exact comparison inverse image and its termwise derived functor [def-sf-comparison-derived-pullback]. Let $U_T=
u_T^*(\mathbf1_{\mathrm{Sh}(T_{\mathrm{et}},\mathcal B)}[0])$ and let $c_T:U_T\simeq\mathbf1_{D(\mathrm{Sh}(T_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal B))}$ be the canonical monoidal coefficient-unit comparison. For every $K\in D(\mathrm{Sh}(T_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal B))$, define the compared left unitor
$$\lambda^{
u}_{T,K}:U_T\otimes^LK\xrightarrow{c_T\otimes1}\mathbf1\otimes^LK\xrightarrow{\lambda_K}K.$$
It is precisely this composite of canonical isomorphisms, including the coefficient comparison; no evaluation or composite-transpose identity is asserted.

lean.statement:
def comparedLeftUnit (B : Type v) [Category.{u + 1} B] [Abelian B]
    [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{u + 1} B] [MonoidalCategory B] [MonoidalPreadditive B]
    [SymmetricCategory B] [MonoidalClosed B] [Abelian.HasFunctorialFlatResolution B]
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (K : DerivedCategory (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) B)) :
    ((derivedTensor B T).obj ((comparisonUpperStar B T).mapDerivedCategory.obj
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj (𝟙_ (Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology B))))).obj K ≅ K
